abilities.name: Airborne Disease Prevention
abilities.caveat: Supporting Fire Tonicshots heal all nearby party members when they hit an enemy, but only while Ifa is hovering in the Nightsoul's Blessing state (after casting this skill). The planner can't track how long Nightsoul lasts, so these healing hits aren't drawn on the timeline.
_curatorNotes: Tonicshot Healing On Hit authored 2026-07-12 as an onHit(normal) team heal. Supporting Fire (Tonicshots) are Ifa's in-Nightsoul Normal Attacks (C6 Oath on a Feathered Knot confirms the extra Tonicshot 'is considered Normal Attack DMG'); each Tonicshot heals all nearby party members based on Ifa's EM upon hitting an opponent (skill kit text + KQM quickguide + Fandom wiki: 'Tonicshot ... will heal all nearby party members based on Ifa's Elemental Mastery upon hitting an opponent'). TL10 sidecar 'Tonicshot Healing On Hit' col 10 (index 9) = '36.3% Elemental Mastery+105.9' -> scaling 36.3 (stat em) + flat 105.9. No gcsim source exists for ifa; all values from the talent sidecar (genshin-db@5.2.12).

Gated on state:nightsoulBlessing so the heal does not fire on the out-of-stance base Normal Attack (Rite of Dispelling Winds, which does not heal). Both Tap and Hold Supporting Fire fire healing Tonicshots, so a single onHit(normal) heal covers both variants (same Healing On Hit row). No proc ICD in the kit text (row is labelled 'On Hit'; Jean Wind Companion is the structural precedent and carries no procCooldown).

opensState/duration deliberately NOT authored: Ifa's Nightsoul's Blessing has no fixed duration (80 Nightsoul points drained by hovering/movement, then Phlogiston; C6 cuts out-of-combat consumption 20%), so per 'never fake timing' the stance is left durationless. Consequence: resolveAbilityTiming sanitizes the missing duration to 0, the stance window is zero-length, and neither inStance nor nightsoulBlessing resolves true in the planner -- so these onHit heal ticks are not rendered on the timeline (see caveat). The capability layer still derives the heal from this effect (state:nightsoulBlessing surfaces as a runtime caveat). If a canonical Nightsoul window is ever modeled, add opensState:'nightsoulBlessing' + a duration and the ticks light up automatically.
abilities.description:
It's time for the real bash bros to step up! Ifa calls Cacucu in as backup.
After using this skill, Ifa gains 80 Nightsoul points and enters the **Nightsoul's Blessing** state. In the Nightsoul's Blessing state, Ifa will hover with Cacucu's help. When he uses Normal Attacks in this state, he will use different kinds of **Supporting Fire** depending on whether you Tap or Hold, firing Tonicshots that are capable of healing all party members.

Additionally, Holding the Elemental Skill Airborne Disease Prevention while Ifa is in Nightsoul's Blessing will cause him to use a Nightsoul-aligned Plunging Attack. Letting go of the skill button will interrupt this Plunging Attack to maintain his hover. If Ifa lands due to this Plunging Attack, his Nightsoul's Blessing state will end.

abilities.name: Compound Sedation Field
abilities.description:
Fires a Therapeutic Sedative at a (temporarily aggressive) opponent. The sedative will explode on impact, creating a restraining wind current that pulls nearby objects and opponents in while dealing Nightsoul-aligned AoE Anemo DMG.
When the Therapeutic Sedative hits an opponent affected by Hydro/Pyro/Cryo/Electro, it will apply a **Sedation Mark** to them.

passives.name: Field Medic's Vision
passives.description: When Ifa is in the Nightsoul's Blessing state, every 1 Nightsoul point out of the total in his entire party will grant him 1 **Rescue Essentials** point. Rescue Essentials will increase the Swirl, Electro-Charged, and Lunar-Charged DMG dealt by nearby party members.

passives.name: Mutual Aid Agreement
_curatorNotes: +80 EM for 10s on team Nightsoul Burst event. Migrated from manual trigger 2026-05-09 with the new onTeamNightsoulBurst trigger (F2C). Target also corrected from "team" → "self" — the description specifies Ifa's EM (the holder's), not a team buff.
passives.description: When nearby party members trigger Nightsoul Bursts, Ifa's Elemental Mastery increases by 80 for 10s.

constellations.name: Vitiferous Elixir's Concoction
constellations.description: When **Supporting Fire** hits an opponent, it will restore 6 Energy for Ifa. One such Energy restoration can be triggered once every 8s.

constellations.name: Guiding Spirit of Ballistic Prayer
constellations.description:
When Ifa is in the Nightsoul's Blessing state, every Nightsoul point the party has above a total of 60 will grant Ifa 4 additional **Rescue Essentials** points.
Additionally, Ifa's Rescue Essentials limit is increased by 50.
You must first unlock the Ascension Talent **Field Medic's Vision**.

constellations.name: Rebuttal in Negotiations With the Night
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of **Airborne Disease Prevention** by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

constellations.name: Decayed Vessel's Permutation
_curatorNotes: A6 rigor 2026-07-12: value corrected 15 → 100 (kit text: 'Ifa gains 100 Elemental Mastery for 15s'; the prior 15 duplicated the duration field). EM buff value is whole-number flat EM per convention. No gcsim source exists for ifa; kit text is authoritative.
constellations.description:
The restraining wind current created by the Elemental Burst **Compound Sedation Field** has its duration extended to 3s.
Additionally, Ifa gains 100 Elemental Mastery for 15s after using his Elemental Burst Compound Sedation Field.

constellations.name: Vow of Universal Coexistence
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of **Compound Sedation Field** by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

constellations.name: Oath on a Feathered Knot
constellations.description:
When Ifa uses the Hold version of his **Supporting Fire**, there is a 50% chance that he will fire an additional Tonicshot that deals 120% of Ifa's ATK as Anemo DMG. This DMG is considered Normal Attack DMG.
Additionally, when he is not in combat, Ifa will consume 20% less Nightsoul points and Phlogiston in his Nightsoul's Blessing state.
